reuse.why: Reuses category selection, amount conversion, tag parsing and undo wrappers, but copyPreviousMonth separately assembles the complete eligibility decision.

duplication.why: Managed-category discovery is shared, but combining visibility eligibility with managed-category exclusion is duplicated between getMonthFillCategories and copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Budget policy stays in budget/actions.ts, tag parsing uses the shared tags module, and method registration follows app.ts conventions.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, focused tests and a relevant release note.

maintainability.why: The helpers and explicit hidden-category option are understandable, though complete eligibility should be centralized to prevent the copy path from drifting.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth bypasses getMonthFillCategories and reconstructs its eligibility composition using isMonthFillCategory and getManagedCategoryIds.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: getMonthFillCategories expresses eligibility as predicate && !managedIds.has(id), while copyPreviousMonth reshapes the same decision into a negated early-return condition.

abstraction_drift.where: actions.ts: includeHiddenCategories is added to getMonthFillCategories and isMonthFillCategory, with one new early-return branch in the predicate; copyPreviousMonth retains a separate composition of eligibility and managed-category exclusion.
